'''2006 Bespin Regional Tyler Vastag DS No Money, No Parts, No Deal!''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Tyler Vastag]] at [[2006 Bespin Regional]], finishing 1st; the list below is as posted on DeckTech by Tyler "tvas27" Vastag (2006-04-30).<ref name="src">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=35535 Fargo Watto-Bespin Region Winner 2k6]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20071209040247/http://decktech.net:80/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=35535 Internet Archive]</ref>

== Original post ==

'''Fargo Watto-Bespin Region Winner 2k6'''
* '''Author:''' Tyler "tvas27" Vastag
* '''Published:''' April 30, 2006
* '''Rating:''' 4.86
* '''Description:''' This is the Watto deck that went 3-1 for me at Bespin Regions. The title comes from my hometown & where we designed & playtested the deck.

=== Strategy ===

Edit-Bah, this is supposed to be an advanced deck.  I forgot to switch it.

End edit-

Here is the Watto deck I used to win Bespin Regions. Props to Brian Herold & Kurt Schlichting for helping me design it & to Kurt for its title.  Backstory-for the past couple of months, I was trying to find a decend DS deck.  I was  running out of ideas, so I built Watto.  I had some experience with it, so I thought it might do okay.  Brian & Kurt & I then playtested it, and decided to add Forced Landing V to the mix.  We decided that with how fast decks set up, we needed a deck that could A) set up fast, and B) deny the opponent the ability to set up fast.  It worked out well.  The early damage is also key, as it throws some players off their game, and that early edge is huge.  Also, props to Justin "nitsuj" Stratton for some advice & for bouncing a few ideas around with me.

Its three wins were in the high 20's & low 30's , and its only loss was in the final confrontation to Garrett Larson's Endor Mains by 10.  Overall, not a bad showing.  I'm posting this because I'm probably going to retire it.  It's not that fun to play against.  Everything, or almost everything, costs the opponent extra force.

Always start IAO/SP & Forced Landing V.  Usually start Endor Shield V, but if you see the WYS V objective, start Crossfire V instead so you can pull Emperor's Power V.  Start YCHF if you see Hidden Base so you can pull Search & Destroy.

The objective of the deck is denial.  Forced Landing limits ^ & V to owner's deploy phase.  No superfluous pulling by the LS player.  Sim V makes the opponent pay 2.  Five Sims means the odds of you getting one in your opening hand are pretty good.  If I were to continue playing this deck, however, I'd add a sixth Sim.  The deck gives up two icons total.  In each of my three wins I had a total lockdown by turn two or three.  The force denail combined with the quick damage and limitations via IAO/SP, Emperor's Power V (pay extra to battle), Projective, Barrier, etc etc etc. makes the deck solid.  Also, the pay 2 or lose 2 function of the deck can also be considered denial.  Either way, it works out well for the DS player.

This deck has all the usuall annoying Watto tricks.  Barriers, Projective, Cease Fire!, Force Field, Emperors Power V, Bad Feeling Have I, & Luke Luuuke V are all great.

Why....

Cmdr Merrjeck, Endor Sheild V, & Endor system-

It's a 2-0 for you & in most games and its a drain 2.  Also, it costs the opponent +1 to deploy or move there, which is right in theme with the deck.  I figured on seeing the LS Endor System, so why not deny them force?  It works out well.  Critics say that Merrejk at one of the docking bays is a liability.  While this may be true, the deck contains lots of evasion.  If the LS player wants to beat up Merrejk, that's okay by me.  It means that they have less characters to attack the Junkyard & characters at Mos Espa.  Also, if you don't get Sim or Lando or Sidious or Blizzard 4 in your opening hand, you can use it to pull Tarkin & flip using him.  GMT is great also.  I've been wanting to use him (my nice mint wb version) in a deck, and he fits great in here.

So few sites-

This deck doesn't need much force to function.  That is one of its strengths.

Lando System V-

Pulls Bad Feeling & Lando V.  Lando V is huge, because the overall destiny isn't very good.  Deploy 2 forfeit 7 is ridiculous.

Limited Resoruces-

Wins games.  I think the merits of this card are well documented.  If for some reason I continue to play this deck, I'd consider adding another.

Cease Fire!-

Combined w/Sim is great.  Really mean if they send an EPP or Mace V to the Junkyard.  No swings, no battle destiny.

Alter x2-

Protect against Sense & get rid of annoying back door effects & Goo.

The deck is a lockdown deck.  It sets up quick, does quick damage, & prevents the opponent from doing their thing.  It is kinda an NPE to play against.  The combination of Forced Landing V & Sim is brutal.  As is the force denial & Watto damage.

I won't go into matchups, most are self explanatory.  Although if people inquire, I'll write some up.  Oh yea, critics say that WYS V can beat this.  To them, I say playtest it.  I've had zero trouble with WYS V.

Enjoy.

Tyler Vastag
